verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device model engine and fine-tuning platform, so in-product AI insights on a user's data is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no such feature. POST /tool_schemas (suggests tool definitions from a product description) and /generations (synthetic training data) are generation utilities for building a model, not insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own data. Model capabilities such as structured extraction are developer building blocks, so none of this earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
